issues.description: Method parameter name mismatch in GroverKakuro.state_preparation: the template implementation (GroverKakuro.state_preparation) declares the third parameter as 'ancilla_register', while the solution implementation and the problem statement use the name 'auxiliary_register'. This inconsistency between the template signature (ancilla_register) and the solution/problem text (auxiliary_register) can confuse students about which parameter name to use when implementing, calling, or overriding the method and may lead to inconsistent code or errors when following examples that assume 'auxiliary_register'.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the parameter name consistent across artifacts. Rename the third parameter in the template GroverKakuro.state_preparation signature from 'ancilla_register' to 'auxiliary_register' and update the signature and any internal references/docstring accordingly so it matches the solution and the problem statement. Alternatively, if 'ancilla_register' is preferred, update the solution and problem statement to use that same identifier everywhere, but keeping 'auxiliary_register' is recommended to match existing docstrings and other exercises.

issues.description: The concept is the auxiliary/ancilla qubit register used for phase-kickback in the Kakuro Grover implementation. The problem statement and the reference solution consistently name this register auxiliary_register, but the template's state_preparation method uses the parameter name ancilla_register while its docstring and other parts of the template refer to auxiliary_register. This inconsistent identifier (ancilla_register vs auxiliary_register) names the same conceptual entity and can confuse students when matching the problem description to the template stub and the solution code, or when implementing other methods that expect the same identifier.
issues.suggestedFix: In the template (ex5_grover_kakuro.py) rename the state_preparation parameter ancilla_register to auxiliary_register and update any internal references and the docstring to use auxiliary_register. Ensure the template uses auxiliary_register consistently across all methods and docstrings to match the problem statement and the solution implementation.
